title: Director at Global Management Consultancy Sees Intuit Activity Staying Flat as Clients Delay Purchases Amid AI Uncertainty
expert: Director, global management consultancy; advises ~15 CPG clients on payroll/HCM solution selection (current, adviser)
verdict: Intuit activity and QuickBooks client counts were flat y/y across the adviser's ~15 CPG clients in Aug-Oct as companies pause tech purchases to assess AI, and the expert sees pricing flat to slightly lower over 12-18 months.

thesis_impact: Tenet 2 (core funnel and pricing): ↓ — flat activity and client count, and pricing seen flat to down via seat reductions.
Tenet 5 (disruption contained): → — share maintained, stickiness stable; AI impact incremental.
Tenet 1 (mid-market): → — Intuit Enterprise Suite relevant for lower-middle market; PE roll-ups an open question.
